source: Calculated with SpekPy + Benmakhlouf KS-ASF-201101-IR Table 1 Eq13, not published clinical nodes

geometry.position: centre of flat entrance surface; square field, normal central-axis incidence
geometry.field_reference: phantom entrance surface, plane perpendicular to beam
geometry.lateral_extent_section_3_2: variable, margin exceeding 5 cm at beam exit
geometry.inconsistency: A fixed 30 x 30 cm phantom conflicts with the 35 x 35 cm field and section 3.2. Both statements are preserved; no resolution is assumed.

limitations: Spectrum at air surface; table/pad spectral hardening not simulated.
Central-axis water phantom normal incidence; no patient-specific scattering.
Excluded spectral kerma limited to 1e-4 and renormalized explicitly.
No interpolation/extrapolation across Al families; no spectrum reconstruction from a single HVL.

qc_conditional_fit.objective: unweighted mean squared relative HVL1 residual, one weight per nominal quality
fit_assumptions: All baseline filtration represented by equivalent Al
Angle 11 degrees from related product document, pending installation confirmation
